item.description:
Release v5.6.4

Changes since v5.6.3

  • feat(ConversationManager): post a fine-grained notification when conversation title changes
  • feat(ConversationManaging): add paginated fetch, single-ID fetch, and per-project count APIs
  • feat(LumiUI): add shimmer effect modifier for skeleton loading views
  • feat(MiniMaxPlugin): add video record persistence, query tools, and settings view
  • feat(MiniMaxPlugin): move MiniMaxTokenPlanProvider to Providers directory
  • feat(WindowMain): collect onboarding pages and inject via environment
  • fix(command): prevent menu action failures and redundant rebuilds
  • fix(ConversationListPlugin): coalesce reload requests during active reload
  • fix(ConversationManager): notify list after persisting conversation to database
  • fix(DeviceInfoPlugin): use Int64 for CPU state counters to prevent Int32 overflow on multi-core machines
  • fix(DiskManagerPlugin): localize remaining hardcoded strings in about view
  • fix(Open*): use Bundle.module for pluginAboutView localization in all Open plugins
  • fix(Plugins): change policy from optIn to alwaysOn for ActivityHeatmap, Download, and IdleTime plugins
  • refactor(ActivityPlugins): update plugin implementations
  • refactor(AgentRulesPlugin): update plugin implementation
  • refactor(AgentTempStoragePlugin): update plugin implementation
  • refactor(AppIconDesignerPlugin): update plugin implementation
  • refactor(AppPlugins): update plugin implementations
  • refactor(AskUserPlugin): update plugin implementation
  • refactor(BrewManagerPlugin): update plugin implementation
